title: A training method for segmented federated learning model based on heterogeneous systems
assignee: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

pse.problem: The current segmentation learning framework faces low training efficiency due to serial training mode and resource disparities among heterogeneous devices.
pse.solution_function: The invention offers a parallel training method for a split federal learning model based on a heterogeneous system. Each client trains its local model using local data, sends crushed data and labels to the central server's server local model for forward calculation and prediction. The server local model calculates gradients and transmits them back to clients for updating their local models. After all local models are updated, the edge server collects parameters from the public layer of the global model and updates it.
pse.solution_structure: The system comprises a plurality of clients, a central server, and an edge server. The global model is split into client local models and corresponding server local models based on each client's resources (storage, calculation frequency, channel conditions).
pse.solution_implementation: In each training round, clients train their local models in parallel, perform forward calculations using local data, and send crushed data and labels to the central server. The central server's server local model performs forward calculations and predicts, calculates gradients, backpropagates them to clients for updating local models. After updates, the edge server collects parameters from the public layer of global models.
pse.effect: Improved training efficiency by parallelizing training and adaptively adjusting to client resources.
